(NYSE:RF) on Monday announced the company is scheduled to participate in the Goldman Sachs 2026 Financial Services Conference on Wednesday, Dec. 9, 2026. Regions’ portion of the conference will begin at approximately 9:20 a.m. ET on that date. Executives from the bank will take part in a fireside chat-style discussion with the conference moderator. The discussion can be live-streamed in a listen-only format. To access the discussion, visit Regions’ Investor Relations page at https://ir.regions.com . A replay will also be made available on the Investor Relations page following the event. About Regions Financial Corporation Regions Financial Corporation (NYSE:RF), with $163 billion in assets, is a member of the SP 500 Index and is one of the nation’s largest full-service providers of consumer and commercial banking, wealth management, and mortgage products and services. articles.summary: Regions outpaces regional and national banking peers, earning high marks for trust, relationships and digital banking experience in this nationwide study. Regions Bank on Thursday announced the company is ranked No. 1 in Overall Satisfaction in the JD Power 2026 U.S. Small Business Banking Satisfaction StudySM . The top ranking reinforces Regions’ commitment to helping small-business owners succeed through trusted relationships, personalized service and convenient banking tools and solutions. Regions Bank ranked No. 1 in Overall Satisfaction in the JD Power 2026 U.S. Small Business Banking Satisfaction Study. Regions scored above the industry average across nearly every dimension measured in the study. The results point to a banking experience built around accessibility, consistency and advice that helps small-business owners confidently make decisions.
